user.title: Music Assistant Voice Tools
user.description: Choose the Music Assistant server whose players the voice assistant should control.

abort.music_assistant_not_found: Set up the Music Assistant integration first.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Music Assistant Voice Tools is already configured.

data_description.default_player: Used when no room is given and the voice satellite has no area, or when a room has several players.
data_description.room_aliases: One per line, for spoken names that differ from area names, e.g. `office: media_player.wiim_office`.
data_description.disabled_tools: Tools to hide from the voice assistant. Fewer tools helps small models.

error.invalid_aliases: Each line must look like `spoken name: media_player.entity_id`.
error.alias_not_music_assistant: Each alias must point to a Music Assistant player, not the speaker's own entity. Look for the entity provided by the Music Assistant integration.
